subject: Request: temporary surge carve-out for hosted commits
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@stellaai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary surge carve-out for hosted commits

Hi Anya,

Quick note following our call this morning — Stella AI expects an unplanned surge tied to a product launch in July that will push you ~3x over your committed hosted API baseline for ~8–12 weeks. Procurement asked if we can provide a time-limited carve-out from the rate card for the overage band to avoid breaking the unit economics of the feature launch.

High-level ask: temporary per-token discount for incremental usage above the existing commit slab (proposed: 35% off our standard hosted per-token rate for tokens above the baseline) for a 90-day window starting July 5. They prefer a simple time box + true-up rather than a long-term amendment.

I attached two files Stella sent: stella_commit_model.xlsx (expected token profile) and a one-pager. Can you and Lauren confirm internal approval path and any required guardrails (caps, audit, PO/prepay, SLA)? Also need an estimate of incremental cost to Redwood (ballpark) so I can provide procurement a yes/no by EOD next Wed.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

— Sergio
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: stella_commit_model.xlsx (Excel)
Attachment: stella_onepager.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary surge carve-out for hosted commits

Sergio —

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed the model quickly. Summary and two internal options to consider:

Option A — Provisional slab (preferred):
- 35% off standard hosted per-token rate on incremental tokens over baseline
- Time-limited: Jul 5–Oct 2 (90 days)
- Cap: maximum 4x baseline incremental tokens; true-up at month-end
- Require PO + 30% prepayment to secure capacity

Option B — Credits + standard rate:
- Keep rate card intact; issue one-time usage credit to offset the margin impact (credit applied monthly)
- Credits tethered to observed overage; lower operational complexity but worse cash predictability

Ballpark impact: if Stella hits their conservative forecast, incremental gross cost to Redwood ~ $85k over 90 days (compute + infra), with net margin hit depending on whether we require prepayment.

We need Pricing Committee signoff for any deviation from published rate card. I can start a price-override request (link below) if you want to pursue Option A.

https://redwood.example.com/price-override-requests/DEAL-8731

Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales Ops

> On Thu, Jun 24, 2027 at 09:12 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Quick note following our call this morning — Stella AI expects an unplanned surge...
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary surge carve-out for hosted commits

Team —

I agree Option A (provisional slab) is cleaner operationally, but we need strict guardrails so this doesn't become a precedent. My recommended approval terms:

- Approval bucket: one-off Pricing Committee exception (max two per quarter per sales rep)
- SLA / audit: require Stella to enable token-level logging for the window and give Redwood read access to usage buckets for verification
- Financial guardrail: 30% prepayment + PO prior to start date; monthly reconciliation with cap enforced
- Legal: require a 90-day addendum with automatic reversion to rate card after window; no rate carry-forward credit unless explicitly agreed

I've attached a provisional line item CSV I use to spin up special rates: redwood_provisional_line_item.csv — finance + legal, please review.

If we proceed, we should file the formal price-override request and include a short P&L of the impact. Can Ben run the cost delta and queue Pricing Committee for a fast review? Need final decision by Wed, Jun 30 EOD to align with Stella's procurement timeline.

— Lauren
VP, Sales Strategy

Attachment: redwood_provisional_line_item.csv (CSV)

> On Thu, Jun 24, 2027 at 11:05 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> > I reviewed the model quickly. Summary and two internal options to consider...
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Legal Pricing Committee <pricing-legal@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary surge carve-out for hosted commits

Folks —

Stella confirmed internally that procurement will raise a PO if we can provide a written interim carve-out. Procurement specifically asked for: the exact line item they can sign, the start/end dates, the cap, and a sample invoice so they can cut the PO quickly. They also flagged the need for an explicit audit window and a confidentiality addendum.

Proposed operational plan (final suggestion before we submit to Pricing Committee):
- Rate: 35% off standard hosted per-token for incremental tokens above baseline
- Window: 2027-07-05 to 2027-10-02 (90 days)
- Cap: 4x monthly overage on any given month; monthly true-up
- Billing: 30% prepay within 7 days of signed PO, remainder net 30 after month reconciliation
- Data: token-level logs retained for 120 days; Redwood read-access for audit

If Legal approves the addendum language and Finance signs off on the P&L delta, I'll request Ben to file the formal price-override. Can someone from Pricing/Legal provide a redline and an approval channel (committee chair) by Wed EOD? Stella's procurement needs the invoice row to include a SKU and custom rate code so their AP system can accept it.

Thanks — I'll be standing by to send the formal doc to Anya as soon as we have approvals.

— Sergio

> On Fri, Jun 25, 2027 at 08:30 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Anya Petrov <anya@stellaai.com>

Cc: Marco Russo <marco@cloudcoop.io>, procurement@stellaai.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary surge carve-out for hosted commits

Sergio —

Thanks for the fast cadence and clear proposed terms. Procurement can expedite a PO once we have a single-line invoice row with the provisional SKU, rate, and the 90-day effective dates. The team is comfortable with the proposed cap and prepayment.

Please send the redlined addendum and the provisional invoice row (CSV or PDF) by EOD today so I can route to Finance. We will queue DocuSign as soon as we have the artifact.

Appreciate the responsiveness — this helps keep our launch timeline intact.

Best,
Anya Petrov
Head of Procurement
Stella AI
